additional_info.subject: Description
additional_info.body:
Hello,
A customer called us because he wanted to charge on the charger n. 313806942001, on the Plug n.2, but he saw it was occupied, even if it was not. We could not perform a reboot because another customer was charging on the plug n. 1.
On Sifinity we see that the charger is disconnected and all plugs are occupied.
Could you please check?
Thank you in advance

All the outlets are working.
Please provide me with a specific timestamp to deep dive in the issue, if you are still facing issues with the charger.

Thank you.
Kind regards,

The customer who faced this issue called us on the 20
th
of December. So, the plug number 2 seemed occupied (even if it was not) between 10:45 a.m. and 11:00 a.m.
Thank you,
Filomena

additional_info.subject: ID0468846-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2 / S7 313806942001] CU check CRM:03097000335
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena,
Thank you for your quick response.
After checking the charger, we found that the OCPP went offline during this time.
This will show that the outlet is unavailable. The OCPP could not establish a connection.
Right now the charger looks healthy and the OCPP connection is stable.
Please provide me with feedback if you are still facing issues with the charger.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
